title: Law requiring notice before evicting older tenants
summary: This bill would require landlords to notify the city Department of Housing Preservation and Development before filing to evict a tenant age 60 or older, including the tenant's name, address and phone number. The department would then send the tenant a list of legal service providers and would publish an annual report analyzing eviction trends and possible discrimination against older tenants, due by July 1 each year. Violating the notice requirement would be a class A misdemeanor, and the law would take effect 120 days after enactment.
